2607.05346.title: OptiAgent: End-to-End Optimization Modeling via Multi-Agent Iterative Refinement
2607.05346.paper_summary: We propose OptiAgent, a multi-agent framework that, given a natural language description of an Operations Research problem, is able to output a solver-ready mathematical formulation as well as executable code. Our architecture prioritizes the mathematical modeling step, where dedicated agents extract structures, such as decision variables and constraints, enabling iterative self-correction. We introduce a novel multi-loop validation architecture with four specialized feedback mechanisms, each targeting a distinct failure mode such as misinterpretation, structural defects, mathematical inconsistencies, validation failures, and code errors. Alongside accuracy, our modular design improves the process of solving optimization problems by improving transparency, as each agent exposes its reasoning and feedback, making the full modeling process auditable. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3 out of 4 benchmarks across LP, MILP, and Nonlinear Programming tasks, while remaining highly competitive on the remaining dataset.
2607.05346.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了OptiAgent，一個多代理框架，它能夠根據運籌學問題的自然語言描述，輸出可供求解器使用的數學公式以及可執行的代碼。<lb/>我們的架構優先考慮數學建模步驟，專門的代理提取結構，例如決策變量和約束，從而實現迭代自我修正。<lb/>我們引入了一種新穎的多循環驗證架構，具有四種專門的反饋機制，每種機制針對不同的失敗模式，如誤解、結構缺陷、數學不一致性、驗證失敗和代碼錯誤。<lb/>除了準確性，我們的模塊化設計通過提高透明度來改善優化問題的解決過程，因為每個代理都會公開其推理和反饋，使整個建模過程可審計。<lb/>我們的框架在LP、MILP和非線性編程任務的四個基準中，有三個達到了最先進的性能，同時在剩餘數據集上仍然保持高度競爭力。
